items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: God Beans was crazy about me you know.

ctx.x: So you'd been in town a while huh? Yeah, I come from the Army in nineteen nineteen.
And you know, pretty much Jack Kerr and then the boys made me quit Jack and we made up a band and put money in. That's how I got to get up there. God Beans was crazy about me you know.
What about Clyde Beatty? You told me you worked for him once. Oh yeah, the animal man. Yeah I worked for Clyde Beatty in there.
